To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the energy-momentum relations for solitary waves of the nonlinear Dirac, the nonlinear Maxwell-Dirac, and the nonlinear Klein-Gordon- Dirac equations are the same as the energy-momentum relationships for point particles; (ii) the mass of the solitary wave equals to the energy of the wave; and (iii) the momentum of the solitary wave is the same as the momentum of the wave.
solitary waves of the Dirac, Klein-Gordon- Dirac and Maxwell-Dirac equations have the same properties as point particles, in particular the energy-momentum relationship.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new type of nonlinear wave equations which have been derived from a variational principle.
nonlinear relativistic equations of mathematical physics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the energy-momenta of the solitary waves of these three equations coincide with the energy-momentum of a particle with the mass of the corresponding solitary wave.
the energy-moment relations for solitary waves of the above mentioned nonlinear Dirac equations coincide with the energy-moment relation of Einstein for point particles.
the energy-moment relations of solitary waves of nonlinear relativistic wave equations coincide with the Einstein energy momentum relations for point particles.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
solitary waves of nonlinear field equations are pointlike objects with mass and spin.
the energy-mo-mentum relation for solitary waves is a universal relation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, contrary to what one might expect, the Einstein energy-moment relation is not a property of the Einstein equations, but rather a general feature of the dynamics of nonlinear relativistic wave equations.
